The closest available metric is **average_order_value_eur** — "Average amount of a non-cancelled order (revenue over non-cancelled orders, over the whole period asked, never an average of daily averages)" — which measures the mean, not the median, and covers all non-cancelled orders in the period rather than a single day unless grouped by day.
